secondary_measure: For each committed manifest write, compare each previously valid account-reference pair with the post-write pairs using actual live release and withdrawal history. Identify editors, desks, reader response and repair. Rejected stale writes never enter the manifest. Independently compare terminal delivery files with each customer inbox and Operations ledger. A lost intermediate row, a missing final customer delivery and an Operations delay are distinct.
